source.notice: Short factual paraphrases, not original PDF pages or complete repair instructions. Fixture page indexes are separate from the original manual's printed/PDF page numbers. Numeric values apply only to the cited stock model and conditions.

pages.title: Engine lubricant drain fastener
pages.text: For the stock 2021 CRF250F, the engine-oil drain fastener requires 24 N·m. Fit a fresh sealing washer.

pages.title: Lubricant quantity by operation
pages.text: 2021 CRF250F lubricant quantities: a routine oil drain with filter replacement takes 1.4 L; engine disassembly requires 1.7 L. These are different operations.

pages.title: Chain inspection and lubrication schedule
pages.text: For the 2021 CRF250F drive chain, inspect and lubricate at 300 mi (500 km) or 3 months, taking the earlier limit. Wet or dusty riding calls for more frequent service.
